Package com.github.crittscott.somestacks.gametest

Class StoragePileGameTests

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somestacks.gametest.StoragePileGameTests
All Implemented Interfaces:
net.fabricmc.fabric.api.gametest.v1.FabricGameTest
public final class StoragePileGameTests extends Object implements net.fabricmc.fabric.api.gametest.v1.FabricGameTest
Storage pile behavior in a live level: deposits filling partial stacks before empty ones, growth when a pile fills, storage insertion addressing the specified slot, obstruction refusing growth, and settling consolidating, packing, and sorting.
